assumptions: WebGL2 is the strict baseline renderer and receives scientific/model state as read-only presentation input.
Optional enhanced backends may improve pixels but may not alter scientific truth, identity, persistence or causal state.
limitations: This provider owns presentation resources and context-loss lifecycle only; it has no canonical scientific authority.
Resource counters are bounded implementation/runtime accounting and are not claims about physical GPU memory.

fidelity.validity: Strict WebGL2 presentation resource ownership, rollback and context-loss lifecycle for the Living product.
fidelity.resolution: Bounded by the active render-quality and resource-budget policies.
fidelity.uncertainty: Visual fidelity varies by browser/GPU while scientific/model state and identity remain backend-invariant.
